blocks.text: Operator precedence (tarteeb ki tarjeeh) batati hai ke expression mein kaunsa amal pehle hoga. Python mein bhi, riyazi (Mathematics) ki tarah, kuch operators ki tarjeeh zyada hai aur woh pehle hal hote hain. Yeh samajhna zaroori hai ta ke hisaab theek ho.

items: Qausain '( )': sab se zyada tarjeeh; andar ka hisaab sab se pehle. (3 + 2) * 4 = 20.
Exponentiation (**, power): is ke baad. 2³, yani 2 ** 3 = 8.
Zarb '*', taqseem '/' aur modulus '%': phir yeh. 4*3 = 12, 10/2 = 5.0 aur 11%3 = 2.
Jama '+' aur tafreeq '-': in ki tarjeeh zarb aur taqseem se kam hai. 5 + 2 = 7 aur 10-4 = 6.
Misaal: 3 + 2*5 mein zarb jama se pehle hogi: 3 + 2*5 = 3 + 10 = 13.

blocks.alt: Chaar khaanon ki seerhi: sab se oopar qausain ( ), phir power **, phir zarb, taqseem aur modulus * / %, aur sab se neeche jama aur tafreeq + -. Baen taraf teer 'pehle' se 'baad mein' ki taraf. Neeche misalein: 3 + 2 * 5 -> 3 + 10 -> 13 aur (3 + 2) * 4 -> 5 * 4 -> 20.
blocks.caption: Operator precedence ki seerhi: jo oopar hai woh pehle hota hai (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
Neeche ki expressions hal karein aur nateeje class fellows aur teacher se milayein.
1. 10 + 3*2 **2-5/5
2. (10 + 3) * (2 ** (2 - 1)) / 5
In ko Python syntax mein likhein (kitab mein kasar (fraction) ki lakeer beech mein chhapi hai):
1. 5 + 3 x4-7 2² +1
2. 10 x (2 + 3) - 4² 8 :  2 +5

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Kitab mein "translate" wali dono expressions ki kasar (fraction) ki shakal chhapai mein bigar gayi hai, is liye un ka theek matlab yaqeeni nahi. Pehli ko agar 5 + (3 x 4 - 7) / (2² + 1) parha jaye to Python mein 5 + (3 * 4 - 7) / (2 ** 2 + 1) likhenge, jis ka jawab 6.0 hai. Yaad rakhein: x ki jagah *, power ke liye ** aur kasar ke upar aur neeche wale hisson ko qausain mein rakhein.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Qausain laga kar lambi expressions saaf ho jati hain aur hisaab usi tarteeb se hota hai jo aap chahte hain.

blocks.prompt: Operator precedence ki tareef kijiye aur aisi misal dijiye jahan yeh nateeja badle (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Yeh qaida hai ke kaunsa amal pehle hoga. 2 + 3 * 4 ka jawab 14 hai kyunke * + se pehle hota hai, jabke (2 + 3) * 4 ka 20.
